name: cbs_board
sql: select e->>'event_id' id, e->>'home' home, e->>'away' away, e->>'start_at' st, e->>'tier' tier, (select jsonb_object_agg(k, jsonb_array_length(v)) from jsonb_each(e->'books') b(k,v)) books from jsonb_array_elements(public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days')->'events') e where e->>'home' ~* '(hurkacz|damm|cobolli|tien|zverev|minaur|alcaraz|fritz)' or e->>'away' ~* '(hurkacz|damm|cobolli|tien|zverev|minaur|alcaraz|fritz)'
